checks: The seven vertices have determinant magnitude four, giving V=4/6!=1/180. Their barycentric coordinates yield the stated inequalities and projection [0,4]; at zero the fiber is conv(0,e_1,e_2) and at four it is {0}. No lattice base outside this interval contributes.

At a slab point with 1<z<3 the new inequalities are strict, so any slab vertex there would also be a vertex of C. There is no such height. The slab is the hull of its boundary fibers, and equal weights at z=2 give K_2=(K_1+K_3)/2. The lifted centroid midpoint is actual.

The barycentric divided-difference integral follows by integrating along lambda_m, yielding the upper-face minus lower-face integrals divided by h_m-h_0, with evaluation at m=0. Smooth approximation recovers the upper tail because the height is nonconstant; differentiation yields m times the truncated power of degree m-1. Repeated knot derivatives of order at most three are continuous for the powers here, so the confluent formulas extend to the stated knots.

Fubini for the original base coordinate gives slice density w(s)/V almost everywhere. Interior slices have continuous volumes and affine moments by compactness and convex interpolation, so the same formulas give the actual values at 1,2,3. The endpoint slices have zero five-volume by dimension.

An independent exact Fraction implementation of confluent divided differences checked six interior points in each of (0,1),(1,3),(3,4), certifying equality to the displayed piecewise polynomials of degree at most five. The integer density table is (0,139/288,1/2,1/32,0), so M/V=73/72 and the normalized weights are (139,144,9)/292, with all three below one half.

The duplicated-coordinate splitting interval has length lambda_i, with probability density ratio 7!/6!, giving the conditional first moments f_{h plus h_i}(s)/(7f_h(s)). Exact arithmetic recovers all the coordinates of g_1, g_3 and y and checks that all barycentric components sum to one with height-weighted sums 1 and 3 at the two centroids.

Exact arithmetic gives the high vertex coordinates 241/3336 and 35/72 and their midpoint 1397/5004>1/4. The closed canonical cap at c has homothety factor 1-c, so its fiber volume scales by (1-c)^5 with exact slice arguments (j-4c)/(1-c).
For c=1/4 the slice arguments are (-4/3,0,4/3,8/3,4). Only integer bases 2,3 contribute. Exact raw mass is (559/3072)V, normalized mass is 1677/9344, and raw deficit is (48739/2239488)V.
For the through-y cap the slice arguments are (-5588,-584,4420,9424,14428)/3607. Only bases 2,3 contribute. Exact normalized mass is 4150356952177626013/28629870146058409344.

The intended independent calculus source is 56a670ccbde263ec, §§2–4; its slice, moment and canonical cap claims are :03, :04 and :05 and include formulas (6)–(11) and (13). The proof derives all three formulas inline, so no pending proof is a premise.
